name: chacha20
note: Verification certificate for the public RFC 8439 ChaCha20 vectors. Section 2.4.2 supplies the key and recovers 114 raw bytes with counter 1, including a partial second block. Section 2.3.2 checks a separate nonce and the independently printed 64-byte block output. plaintext_sha256 hashes recovered raw bytes, not the hex string. This is supplied-key stream decryption with no Poly1305 authentication and no claim of unknown-key recovery, an attack on a configured service, or a cryptographic break. Binary hex fields are intentionally separate from the classical text router's plaintext and ciphertext fields.
